title: SDUI-R Payload (v2.3)
description: Authoritative STRUCTURAL schema for @fajekrina/sdui-r. sdui-r (v2.0) splits a screen into a TEMPLATE (structure + behavior; every node has an id and an order; reusable across screens and merchants) and a VALUE SET (content per template component, per merchant screen), signed and delivered separately and composed by the client. A resolved screen payload (what the client composes) is still accepted for previews and tests. Derived from @fajekrina/sdui v1.1 and murti.schema.json v1 (Apache-2.0, see NOTICE). Tree depth, total node count, action-chain depth, load-request count, id uniqueness, order uniqueness among siblings, value ids existing in the template, and semantic resolution are enforced by the client validator — see spec/README.md. v2.3 adds screen state (`state`) and the state-bound node props `visibleWhen`, `disabledWhen`, `maskedWhen`, `transition` and `toggle` (#/$defs/nodeProps): the schema (CI + backend) is strict about their shape; a client that meets one it cannot evaluate falls back per prop instead of rejecting the screen.

envelope.description: Production transport wrapper. The client verifies the signature (and optionally decrypts) BEFORE trusting the payload.

alg.description: Signature algorithm. The app verifies with its embedded public key.

keyId.description: v1.1 — which signing key produced the signature (key rotation). Absent: the single configured key.

enc.description: Present ONLY when the payload is encrypted (hybrid/envelope encryption). Absent means signed-but-plaintext.

payload.description: Base64 of the UTF-8 payload JSON, or of the ciphertext when 'enc' is present. ~1 MiB cap.

signature.description: Base64 signature over the raw (pre-base64) 'payload' bytes.

payload.description: A resolved screen tree — what the client composes from a template and its values. Accepted for previews and tests; sdui-r services deliver templates and value sets.

componentId.description: A template component id — the key a value set uses. Unique within one template tree (client validator).

templateNode.description: A template node: like a node, but id and order are required. Orders are unique among siblings and ids within the tree (client validator).

props.description: Default values; a value set overrides them per id (shallow merge).

templateDocument.description: What the template service signs and delivers (inside an envelope in production).

key.description: Template key (reusable across screens and merchants).

version.description: Release version; a released template is immutable.

title.description: Shown in the Screen Builder palette.

load.description: v1.1 — named requests run in PARALLEL when the screen opens; each result merges into the data context under its request name. The client bound maxLoadRequests applies.

variants.description: Per-width layouts; the same ids receive the same values.

valuesDocument.description: What the value service signs and delivers (inside an envelope in production).

screen.description: The merchant screen key these values are for.

template.description: The exact template release; a mismatch is rejected.

components.description: Per template component id. Ids the template lacks are rejected (client validator).

componentValue.description: Content props merged over the template props (shallow). Only the content props of the component type (spec/content.json) are valid - style, layout and the action belong to the template (checked against the template by the client validator and the backend).

bundle.description: The client transport/cache unit: a template and its value set, each verified on its own.

schemaVersion.description: MAJOR.MINOR. Consumers match on MAJOR; an unknown MINOR renders-what-it-can (forward-compatible).

key.description: Stable screen key. Must resolve in the ScreenFactory (a semantic check the client performs).

load.description: v1.1 — named requests run in PARALLEL when the screen opens; each result merges into the data context under its request name. The client bound maxLoadRequests applies.

variants.description: v1.1 — optional per-width layouts (compact < 600px ≤ wide). 'root' stays the fallback.

node.description: A node. 'type' is an OPEN vocabulary (the component registry is extensible); the client's semantic layer confirms it resolves, otherwise the Null-Object fallback renders a placeholder.

id.description: Optional stable identity for rendering. Synthesized from the position if absent.

order.description: v2.0 — position among siblings (render order). Required in templates.

props.description: A component's props bag. OPEN by design: unknown keys are ignored (forward-compatible). String values are length-bounded via #/$defs/value.

screenState.description: v2.3 — the screen state: named values a screen keeps while it is open (lost when it closes). State `x` lives in the data context as `$selected.x` — the same place a v2.2 choice group writes (`button.group`), so a choice group is a state. `initial` (default "") may hold {{token}}s; until the state is first set it is re-resolved against the data, so a value the backend stored (sent earlier through action params as {{$selected.x}}) and returns in `load` data comes back. A group or toggle used without a declaration still works and starts empty.

nodeProps.description: A node's props: the open props bag, with the v2.3 state-bound props checked for shape. Template (design) props — never content.

visibleWhen.description: v2.3 — every component: shown only while the condition holds; hidden, it takes no space and leaves the accessibility tree.

disabledWhen.description: v2.3 — button, textField, textArea, picker: disabled while the condition holds.

maskedWhen.description: v2.3 — text: its value is replaced by a mask while the condition holds (a balance behind an eye button). Cosmetic: it hides the value from onlookers, not from the client.

toggle.description: v2.3 — button: a tap flips state `$selected.<toggle>` between "on" and "" (before its action runs, like a choice).

font.description: v2.3 — text: a font NAME (never CSS). rounded · serif · mono are built in; a host maps any name with the CSS variable --sdui-font-<name> (native: its own font table). Unknown → the default font.

letterSpacing.description: v2.3 — text: extra space between letters, in px.

lineHeight.description: v2.3 — text: line height as a multiple of the size (default 1.3).

condition.description: v2.3 — one condition: exactly one source (`state`: `$selected.<state>`; `request`: `$request.<request>` = pending · success · error, kept by the engine for every `api` action) and exactly one operator. Values compare as strings; an unset state is "". AND = nest containers; anything richer is computed by the backend into one field.

transition.description: v2.3 — how a change is animated, per kind of change. `visible` (with visibleWhen): none (default) · fade · collapse (shrinks along the parent's axis). The engine owns the durations and drops them under reduced motion; the first render is never animated.

value.description: Any JSON scalar/array/object. Strings are length-bounded wherever they appear.

action.description: An action. 'type' is a CLOSED vocabulary. onSuccess/onError form a bounded LINEAR chain (max depth enforced by the client validator). Targets are named references (screen key / named request / named link / named native command) — never raw URLs.

presentation.description: v1.1 — navigate: how the host presents the next screen. Default push.

request.description: api: an allow-listed NamedRequest, mapped to method + path by the app bundle.

link.description: openURL: an allow-listed NAMED link. Not a raw URL — the identifier pattern structurally rejects 'https://...'.

command.description: v1.1 — native: a host command allow-listed by the app (e.g. biometricConfirm, share).

params.description: Seeds the target's data context (navigate) or supplies request/command params (api/native). String values may be {{token}}s.

identifier.description: A named reference (screen key, request, link, command). Alphanumeric + underscore; the pattern rejects URLs, paths, and injection.

typeName.description: A component type. Dots allowed for third-party namespacing, e.g. 'ext.lottie'.
